commands.review_summary:
The PR adds ordered mobile pairing gateway route fallbacks across setup-code generation, gateway protocol output, the device-pair plugin, CLI/docs, Control UI, and iOS route probing, while also carrying unrelated Watch, WhatsApp, voice-call, TUI, and session changes.

Reproducibility: yes. by source inspection and linked issue evidence: current main lacks gatewayUrls or route fallback handling in the pairing setup-code path, so a LAN-only advertised URL cannot fall back to Tailnet. I did not run a live macOS plus iPhone Tailscale repro in this read-only review.
